summary: Testing of Webstore Management UI bug fixes. All 5 reported bugs have been verified as FIXED. Product toggle only affects clicked product, state resets when switching stores, badge positioned correctly, QR code visible in Settings tab, branding data (logo URL and accent color #FF5722) displays correctly.

minor.details: Dashboard tab shows 'Failed to load analytics' error, but this doesn't affect the tested functionality

bug_1_product_toggle.description: Product toggle only affects the clicked product - tested by clicking first switch and verifying only that switch changed state
bug_1_product_toggle.evidence: Switch 1 changed from 'unchecked' to 'checked', Switches 2 and 3 remained 'unchecked'

bug_2_state_persistence.description: Product toggle state resets correctly when switching between stores
bug_2_state_persistence.evidence: Successfully opened Test Store (business), then Second Store (fundraiser) - each showed independent product states

bug_3_badge_position.description: Badge in store details modal is positioned inline with title, not overlapping close button
bug_3_badge_position.evidence: Dialog header has pr-8 padding-right, badge is in flex container after DialogTitle with gap-2

bug_4_qr_code.description: QR code is visible in Settings & Branding tab linking to store URL
bug_4_qr_code.evidence: QR code container with data-testid='store-qr-code' found, displays alongside store URL with Copy Link and Open Store buttons

bug_5_branding_data.description: Branding information from store creation displays correctly in settings view
bug_5_branding_data.evidence: Second Store shows logo URL (https://placehold.co/200x100/FF5722/white?text=Logo2) and accent color #FF5722 (orange)

store_link_feature.description: Store link visible with Copy and Open buttons
store_link_feature.evidence: Public Store Link displayed with full URL, Copy Link button and Open Store button present

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All reported bugs verified as FIXED

seed_data_creation: None - Used existing stores (Test Store and Second Store)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webstore Management UI bug fixes verified. Two test stores exist: Test Store (business type) and Second Store (fundraiser type with branding data - logo URL and #FF5722 accent color). QR code library (qrcode.react) is installed and working. Note: Analytics API returns errors but doesn't affect core functionality.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable - all bugs confirmed as fixed by main agent's implementation changes
